AI Overview
War the Knights is a medieval action and strategy video game where players join rival factions to fight large-scale battles, capture flags, and control territory. 
Key Game Features
Factions: Choose to fight for opposing sides like the Island or the Coast. 
Arsenal: Equip long swords, fists, maces, one-handed swords, long spears, bows, crossbows, shields, and magic. 
Nintendo
 +1
Combat Mechanics: Ride horses, use siege equipment, throw explosive barrels, and respawn closer to the front lines by capturing flags. 
Nintendo
Platforms: Available to play on web browsers via platforms like CrazyGames and Bubblebox, as well as on the Nintendo Switch.
